ability.name: Step 6 — Targeted Version & Banner Deepening
ability.description: Perform precise query requests against high-value systems to retrieve server roles and domain details prior to gating decisions.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $error.Clear(); $servicesFile = "$d\services.json"; if (Test-Path $servicesFile) { $services = Get-Content $servicesFile | ConvertFrom-Json; foreach ($ip in $services.psobject.Properties.Name) { $ports = $services.$ip; foreach ($p in $ports) { if ($p.port -eq 445) { Write-Output "FINGERPRINTING SMB ON $ip"; $netView = net view \\$ip 2>&1; Write-Output "BANNER $ip`:445 : $netView" }; if ($p.port -eq 389) { Write-Output "FINGERPRINTING LDAP ON $ip"; try { $de = New-Object System.DirectoryServices.DirectoryEntry("LDAP://$ip/RootDSE"); $dnsHostName = $de.Properties['dnsHostName'].Value; $defaultNamingContext = $de.Properties['defaultNamingContext'].Value; Write-Output "BANNER $ip`:389 : dnsHostName=$dnsHostName, defaultNamingContext=$defaultNamingContext" } catch { Write-Output "BANNER $ip`:389 : rootDSE query failed" } } } } } else { Write-Output "WARN: No services.json found to deepen fingerprints." } } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\step6.txt

rationale: Verifies precise Active Directory indicators dynamically without loud broad sweeps.
